Package neqsim.process.engineering.dexpi

Class Dexpi20EngineeringMaterializer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.dexpi.Dexpi20EngineeringMaterializer
final class Dexpi20EngineeringMaterializer extends Object
Adds governed instrumentation, safeguards and explicit boundaries to native DEXPI 2.0 XML.
